controls.name: automatic-scalar-identity
controls.source:
Option Explicit
Public src As Worksheet, calc As Worksheet, held As Range, localName As Name
Function Observe() As String
Dim n As Name, result As String
result="sheet=" & src.Name & ";code=" & src.CodeName & ";held=" & held.Address(External:=True) & ";formula=" & calc.Range("A1").Formula & ";value=" & CStr(calc.Range("A1").Value2) & ";self=" & src.Range("B1").Formula & ";selfValue=" & CStr(src.Range("B1").Value2)
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
result=result & ";name=[" & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & ":" & n.Comment & "]"
Next
Observe=result
End Function
Function TryRename(ws As Worksheet, target As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ws.Name=target
TryRename="OK"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryRename="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim result As String
Application.Calculation=-4105
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.CalculateBeforeSave=False
Set src=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Sheet1"
Set calc=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
calc.Name="Calc"
src.Range("A1").Value2=3
src.Range("B1").Formula="=Sheet1!A1*2"
calc.Range("A1").Formula="=Sheet1!A1*2"
Set held=src.Range("A1")
result="before=[" & Observe() & "]"
src.Name="O'Brien renamed"
result=result & ";renamed=[" & Observe() & "]"
held.Value2=9
result=result & ";edited=[" & Observe() & "]"
Probe=result & ";final=[" & Observe() & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function

controls.name: strings-indirect-local-reference
controls.source:
Option Explicit
Public src As Worksheet, calc As Worksheet, held As Range, localName As Name
Function Observe() As String
Dim n As Name, result As String
result="sheet=" & src.Name & ";code=" & src.CodeName & ";held=" & held.Address(External:=True) & ";formula=" & calc.Range("A1").Formula & ";value=" & CStr(calc.Range("A1").Value2) & ";self=" & src.Range("B1").Formula & ";selfValue=" & CStr(src.Range("B1").Value2)
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
result=result & ";name=[" & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & ":" & n.Comment & "]"
Next
Observe=result
End Function
Function TryRename(ws As Worksheet, target As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ws.Name=target
TryRename="OK"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryRename="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim result As String
Application.Calculation=-4105
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.CalculateBeforeSave=False
Set src=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Sheet1"
Set calc=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
calc.Name="Calc"
src.Range("A1").Value2=3
src.Range("B1").Formula="=Sheet1!A1*2"
calc.Range("A1").Formula="=Sheet1!A1*2"
Set held=src.Range("A1")
calc.Range("A2").Formula="=""Sheet1!A1"""
calc.Range("A3").Formula="=INDIRECT(""Sheet1!A1"")"
src.Range("C1").Formula="=A1"
src.Name="Renamed"
result="literal=" & calc.Range("A2").Formula & ";indirect=" & calc.Range("A3").Formula & ";indirectError=" & CStr(IsError(calc.Range("A3").Value2)) & ";implicit=" & src.Range("C1").Formula
Probe=result & ";final=[" & Observe() & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
